title: Bedside Table
author: Kingdriver
description:
Bedside Table:

I have designed a table here that can be assembled to the bed in under a minute, providing a convenient bedside surface. The book shown in the image has 1275 pages and thus considerable weight, yet the table supports it and my iPad without any issues.

The grey bracket visible in the first image is another one of my models, which you can find on my profile.
